battle.name: 奧地利王位繼承戰爭
battle.theater: 西里西亞、摩拉維亞與佛蘭德斯
battle.brief: 一七四〇年十月查理六世病逝，奧地利王位繼承權成為歐洲爭端的核心；腓特烈二世於十二月率軍越境西里西亞，一七四一年莫爾維茨與一七四二年霍恩弗里德貝格的兩次會戰，把西里西亞變成普魯士的領土。輪發手槍在火槍與刺刀主導的時代已退居軍官與近衛的佩槍，成為軍階與榮譽的標記，而非戰場上的火力。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 一七四〇年十月二十日，哈布斯堡皇帝查理六世在布魯塞爾病逝，沒有男性繼承人。他的長女、二十三歲的奧地利女大公瑪麗亞·特蕾莎依《一七一三年波拉日克詔令》繼承奧地利、匈牙利、波希米亞、摩拉維亞、西里西亞與奧屬尼德蘭的世襲領土，這場戰爭也以她的名字記在史冊上。哈布斯堡方面並非單一軍隊，而是三層編制：奧地利世襲領地的常備軍與近衛、從帝國等級會議各邦湊出的帝國援軍，以及波希米亞、薩克森方向臨時徵發的輔助兵。帝國的指揮傳統是由王室另一位成員掛帥——查理六世死時，他的兄弟洛林的查理·亞歷山大正好擔任奧地利軍總司令，同年十月二十七日也跟著病逝，軍權先後落在達恩侯爵與實際主持作戰的內伊珀格手中，洛林親王查理與洛桑則在實戰中嶄露頭角。瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的政權靠一班哈布斯堡籍文官支撐，豪格維茨伯爵後來把軍務、外交與財政綁在一起重建了這臺戰爭機器，宮廷總管海因茨多爾夫則主持內務。普魯士方面，國王腓特烈二世自任全軍統帥，步兵操練由老戴斯勞親王一手包辦，冬季參謀由溫特費爾特襄贊，騎兵作戰由齊岑等人主導；普魯士的優勢不在兵力而在體質，全國人口不足哈布斯堡君主國的一半，卻已建成一支以統一射擊紀律、線狀射擊與刺刀衝鋒為核心的軍隊。巴伐利亞選侯查理·阿爾伯特是查理六世亡妻的兄弟，他主張帝國境內最接近的女性親屬有權繼承普法爾茨，並要求以普法爾茨作為支持瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的代價；薩克森選侯奧古斯特三世身兼波蘭國王，兩者的選票一開始都反對瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的丈夫洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡被選為皇帝。英國與荷蘭以布拉格派軍的名義與哈布斯堡並肩作戰，英王喬治二世同時是漢諾威選侯，他不能眼看帝國落入巴伐利亞之手；法國則聯手巴伐利亞、西班牙與一批德意志小邦，並在低地國家、義大利與北德另開戰線，荷蘭共和國始終保持中立，瑞典與丹麥置身事外。
countriesEn: On 20 October 1740 the Habsburg emperor Charles VI died of illness in Brussels without a male heir. His elder daughter, the twenty-three-year-old Austrian archduchess Maria Theresa, succeeded under the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 to the hereditary lands of Austria, Hungary, Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia and the Austrian Netherlands, and the war was afterwards named for her. On the Habsburg side there was not a single army but three layers: the standing army and household troops of the Austrian hereditary lands, contingents supplied by the states of the Imperial Diet in the form of a Reichsheer, and auxiliaries hastily raised from Bohemia and Saxony. The Imperial tradition was to entrust command to another prince of the house: at the moment Charles VI died, his brother Charles Alexander of Lorraine was serving as commander-in-chief of the Austrian army and died of a fever on 27 October; command then passed to Count Daun and, in practice, to Neipperg, while Prince Charles of Lorraine and the young Laudon first made their names in the field. Maria Theresa's state rested on a cadre of Habsburg officials: Count Haugwitz, who would later bind finance, recruiting and diplomacy together and rebuild the war machine, and Count Zinzendorf, who ran the household. On the Prussian side the king commanded in person; the infantry drill belonged to Leopold of Anhalt-Dessau, the winter staff work to Winterfeldt and the cavalry to men such as Zieten. Prussia's strength was not in numbers but in character: its population was less than half that of the Habsburg dominions, yet it already possessed an army built on a uniform rate of fire, linear fire and the bayonet charge. The Elector of Bavaria, Charles Albert, was the brother of Charles VI's late wife; he claimed that the nearest female relative in the Empire should inherit the Electoral Palatinate and demanded the Palatinate as the price of his support for Maria Theresa. The Elector of Saxony, Augustus III, was King of Poland as well, and both men at first withheld their votes from Francis Stephen of Lorraine, Maria Theresa's husband. Britain and the Dutch Republic fought beside the Habsburgs in what was called the Pragmatic Army, and George II, being Elector of Hanover as well as King of Britain, could not afford to see the Empire pass to Bavaria. France, for its part, joined Bavaria, Spain and a cluster of small German states, and opened separate fronts in the Low Countries, in Italy and in northern Germany; the Dutch stayed neutral throughout, and Sweden and Denmark stood aside.
people: 這場戰爭裡真正推動決策的人不多，每一方都有兩三個關鍵名字。哈布斯堡一邊的核心是瑪麗亞·特蕾莎本人：她以二十三歲之齡接位，第一件事是宣布自己唯一的責任就是保住國家與領土，此後她在前線與內廷之間靠書信往返，主持每一次軍務會議，決定每一次和與戰；她倚重的文官是豪格維茨伯爵，這位帝國首相把軍費、兵員編制與外交綁在一起，重建了哈布斯堡的戰爭機器，而她的丈夫洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡則必須在帝國撐住選舉與外交。普魯士那邊是腓特烈二世，他的兩面性在這場戰爭裡暴露無遺：一方面他用一四七〇年以來的封建權利與詔令遭違背的名義為越境辯護，另一方面在莫爾維茨與霍恩弗里德貝格之間展現出遲疑、急躁與果決交替的指揮風格；他的兄弟奧古斯特·威廉親王在莫爾維茨負傷，參謀長溫特費爾特在查托西茨受傷，步兵的老戴斯勞親王則以操典與陣形決定了普軍的靈魂。盟邦方面，巴伐利亞選侯查理·阿爾伯特是整場交易的樞紐，他以支持瑪麗亞·特蕾莎為籌碼換取普法爾茨，又把法軍引進帝國；薩克森選侯兼波蘭國王奧古斯特三世扮演雙重角色，既要保住薩克森的選侯位，又要應付波蘭王位帶來的內部動盪與財政壓力。英國的喬治二世在漢諾威選侯的身分下於一七四三年六月二十七日親率聯軍在德廷作戰，成為英國史上最後一位親自上陣的君主；同行的英軍總指揮坎伯蘭公爵則在一七四五年豐特努瓦戰敗後名聲重挫。法國最傑出的戰術家是元帥莫里斯·德·薩克斯，他在兵力劣勢下用兩道縱深贏得了豐特努瓦；貝勒伊爾元帥在德廷慘敗後接管低地國家戰場，卻在一七四七年圍攻里爾時陣亡。聯軍一方的總指揮是黑森-卡塞爾的威廉親王，符騰堡的菲利普親王在霍恩弗里德貝格獨當一面卻被夜行軍迂迴，達恩、內伊珀格與洛桑則在奧地利軍內輪流主導作戰，戰後的軍制改革則是豪格維茨與瑪麗亞·特蕾莎共同推動的。
peopleEn: Few names actually drove the decisions in this war; each side had two or three indispensable figures. At the centre of the Habsburg side was Maria Theresa herself. She inherited at twenty-three and her first act was to declare that her only duty was to save the state and its lands; from then on she moved between front and cabinet by correspondence, presiding over every council of war and settling every question of peace or war. The official she relied upon was Count Haugwitz, the imperial chancellor who tied money, recruiting and diplomacy into one system and rebuilt the Habsburg war machine, while her husband Francis Stephen of Lorraine had to hold the imperial election and the diplomacy together. On the Prussian side stood Frederick II, whose two-facedness showed plainly here: on one hand he justified the crossing of the border with the old feudal claims dating from 1470 and the alleged violation of the Pragmatic Sanction; on the other he showed an alternation of hesitation, irritability and decision between Mollwitz and Hohenfriedberg. His brother Prince August Wilhelm was wounded at Mollwitz, his chief of staff Winterfeldt was wounded at Chotusitz, and the soul of the Prussian infantry was the drill and the formations of the old Dessau. Among the allies, the Elector of Bavaria Charles Albert was the pivot of the whole bargain, trading his support for Maria Theresa for the Palatinate and bringing French troops into the Empire; the Elector of Saxony and King of Poland Augustus III played a double role, having to hold his electoral dignity while coping with the unrest and financial strain that the Polish crown brought him. George II, fighting in his capacity as Elector of Hanover, led the allied army in person at Dettingen on 27 June 1743, the last British monarch to take the field in person; the British commander Cumberland suffered a severe loss of reputation after the defeat at Fontenoy in 1745. The outstanding French tactician was Marshal Maurice de Saxe, who won Fontenoy against superior numbers with a two-deep deployment; Marshal Belle-Isle took over the Low Countries after his defeat at Dettingen and was killed during the siege of Lille in 1747. On the allied side command belonged to Prince William of Hesse-Kassel; Prince Philip of Württemberg was given an independent command at Hohenfriedberg and was outflanked by the night march; Daun, Neipperg and Laudon took turns directing operations inside the Austrian army, and the military reform that followed the war was pushed by Haugwitz together with Maria Theresa.
kits: 輪發手槍在這場戰爭裡的位置很特別：它已經不是武器，而是身分。到一七四〇年代，燧發槍技術在歐洲早已成熟，線狀步兵的火槍、刺刀與野戰炮才是決定會戰的東西；但輪發手槍因為機構昂貴、造價遠高於燧發手槍，仍以配給制保留在軍官、軍士與近衛手中。奧地利與薩克森的近衛營歷來配備輪發手槍、騎槍與戟，專職護衛君主與軍旗；普魯士的御前侍從、各營軍官與軍士同樣佩帶。輪發手槍的優點是不易走火、備弦後可隨時擊發，缺點則是機構怕潮怕污、裝填與發射比燧發手槍慢、零件磨損後精度下降，只能交給有專人維護的少數人使用；在潮濕多雨的冬季與春季，它更容易在關鍵時刻哑火，這也是它被燧發手槍逐步取代的原因。除此之外，戰場上真正主角是火槍與刺刀：普魯士步兵裝備自製的長身滑膛火槍配插座式刺刀，操練重點是齊射、腿步與列線的整齊，另有專責的擲彈兵與工兵；奧地利步兵除自產燧發火槍外，還大量使用普軍在戰役中繳獲的各式火槍。騎兵方面，哈布斯堡一邊有胸甲騎兵、龍騎兵與匈牙利驃騎，普魯士一邊有胸甲騎兵黑騎士、龍騎兵與齊岑的輕騎，雙方大量使用馬刀與馬槍。炮兵是會戰的骨幹：普軍以三磅、六磅與十二磅野戰炮組成炮兵連，奧軍與聯軍的火炮數量屢佔上風，豐特努瓦一役聯軍有百門炮對法軍的二十餘門。攻城靠浮橋、壕溝器材、攻城臼炮與地雷爆破，圍城補給靠牛車與大篷車，傷兵靠普魯士那支規模驚人的戰地醫院車隊隨軍轉移，騎兵偵察與糧道安全則直接決定野戰的方向。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol occupies an unusual place in this war: it is no longer a weapon but a badge of rank. By the 1740s the flintlock was long since mature in Europe, and it was the muskets, bayonets and field guns of the line infantry that decided battles; the wheellock, whose mechanism was costly and whose price far exceeded that of a flintlock, nevertheless survived by regulation as an issue to officers, NCOs and the household guard. The guard companies of Austria and Saxony had long been equipped with wheellock pistols, carbines and halberds, their business being the personal protection of the sovereign and the regimental colours; the Prussian equerries, regimental officers and NCOs carried it in the same way. Its advantages were that it could not fire accidentally and could be left cocked and ready; its disadvantages were that the mechanism suffered from damp and dirt, that loading and firing were slower than with a flintlock, and that worn parts reduced its accuracy, so it could only be entrusted to a few men who maintained it. In the wet winters and wet springs of the war it was the more likely of the two to fail at the critical moment, and that is why flintlocks steadily displaced it. Everything else on the field belonged to musket and bayonet. Prussian infantry carried a long smoothbore musket of their own manufacture with a socket bayonet, their drill turning on rate of fire, the leg step and the alignment of the line, with separate grenadiers and engineer companies. Austrian infantry used Austrian flintlocks but also large numbers of muskets captured from the Prussians in the field. On the cavalry side the Habsburgs had cuirassiers, dragoons and Hungarian hussars, the Prussians the black cuirassiers, dragoons and Zieten's light horse, both sides using sabre and carbine in bulk. Artillery was the backbone of every battle: the Prussian gun was organised in three- and six- and twelve-pounder batteries, the Austrian and allied batteries were repeatedly outnumbered, and at Fontenoy a hundred allied guns faced the French twenty-four. Siege work rested on pontoons, trench tools, siege mortars and mines; the besiegers' supply moved on ox carts and covered wagons; the wounded moved with the enormous Prussian field hospital train; and mounted scouting and the security of the magazine line decided the direction of every field operation.
tactics: 普魯士的戰術是十八世紀歐洲最完整的一套線狀作戰：步兵以三行縱隊展開，前兩行依射擊操典交替齊射，第三行留作後備，前沿炮兵以齊射壓住敵陣，然後在掩護射擊下向前行進，最後以刺刀接戰；縱隊之間保持嚴格間隔與腿步，使全軍在同一節奏下整體推進。腓特烈二世把這套東西用到極致：一七四一年四月九日的莫爾維茨會戰出現教科書式的一幕，普軍在暴雪掩護下悄然前進，主力迂迴到奧軍側後直取聯軍的後方營與輜重車隊，雖然普軍隨即被內伊珀格率預備隊反擊而一度退卻，國王仍以齊射與陣形穩住陣腳，再整隊奪回陣地。一七四二年六月四日的霍恩弗里德貝格更進一步，普軍在夜裡行軍二十餘公里，拂曉進入陣地，先以炮火掃射奧軍右翼營地，再全線出擊，把符騰堡的菲利普親王率領的側翼整個包了進去。奧地利與帝國軍隊的戰術則是典型的遲緩正面攻勢：步兵同樣線狀展開，但常把縱隊放在另一側的斜後方，準備在對手攻勢耗盡時以縱隊反擊；缺點是整體動作慢、機動範圍小，一旦側翼被迂迴就難以補救，而且一七四〇年代帝國軍的指揮中樞在維也納，決策與調兵的速度遠落後於戰場變化。低地國家的戰役裡法軍靠攻城技藝取勝：一七四六年秋貝勒伊爾圍攻里爾，以壕溝、炮壘與地雷逐步壓縮城防，聯軍以反攻與馳援相抗，一七四七年七月拉費爾德會戰聯軍再敗，一七四八年秋《阿亨條約》簽訂時里爾仍未陷落。豐特努瓦的部署最值得記錄：一七四五年五月十一日，莫里斯·德·薩克斯把法軍排成兩道大縱深，翼側故意留空引誘聯軍攻擊，中央集中兵力與壓倒性的步兵炮兵；聯軍雖有約九萬人，但百門炮分散在一線，無法同時展開，結果被法軍以縱隊反覆衝擊突破中央，再由兩翼捲入，聯軍全線崩潰，英軍的近衛步兵營與高地團在亂軍中以刺刀反衝才勉力收復部分陣地。補給線與天候同樣關鍵：普軍的冬季遠征靠徵發與奪取西里西亞的穀物與麥酒，泥濘與嚴寒拖慢了一切；奧地利與聯軍的糧道靠多瑙河與易北河的水運和篷車隊維持，龐大的醫院車隊與攻城炮列使任何一次轉向都成為一場後勤災難。
tacticsEn: Prussian method was the most complete system of linear warfare in eighteenth-century Europe. The infantry deployed in three lines, the first two delivering alternate volleys in strict drill, the third held in reserve; the guns in front silenced the opposing front, the infantry then advanced under covering fire, and the business was finished with the bayonet. Intervals between columns and the leg step kept the whole army moving on one rhythm. Frederick II pushed this to its limit. At Mollwitz on 9 April 1741 the Prussians came on unseen through a heavy snowstorm and the main body turned the Austrian flank to fall on the baggage and camp of the allied army; the counterstroke of the Austrian reserve under Neipperg drove them back for a time, but the king steadied the line with volleys and formations, re-formed and recovered his ground. Hohenfriedberg on 4 June 1742 went further: the Prussians marched twenty miles or more by night, entered their position at first light, swept the Austrian right with artillery fire and then attacked along the whole front, enveloping the flank commanded by Prince Philip of Württemberg. Austrian and Imperial method was the slow frontal attack. The infantry formed line as elsewhere, but a column was habitually placed obliquely to one flank so that a counterstroke could be launched once the opponent's effort was spent; the weakness was the slowness of the whole manoeuvre, the narrow range of movement, and the impossibility of patching a flanked wing, compounded by the fact that in the 1740s the directing mind of the Imperial army sat in Vienna, where decisions and transfers of troops moved far more slowly than the battlefield. In the Low Countries the French won by the craft of siege: in the autumn of 1746 Belle-Isle invested Lille, closing in by trench, battery and mine, and the allies answered with counterstroke and relief; after the allied defeat at Lauffeld in July 1747 and until the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle in the autumn of 1748, Lille did not fall. The deployment at Fontenoy deserves the closest study. On 11 May 1745 Maurice de Saxe drew the French army in two great lines, deliberately leaving the flanks open to draw the allies in, and concentrated his strength in the centre; the allies had perhaps ninety thousand men, but their hundred guns stood in a single line and could not all be brought to bear, and the French broke the centre with repeated column attacks and then rolled the flanks in, the whole allied line collapsing, while the British foot guards and the highland regiments recovered some ground in the confusion by charging back with the bayonet. Supply lines and weather mattered as much as tactics: the Prussian winter march depended on requisitioning and on taking the grain and beer of Silesia, and mud and frost slowed everything; the Austrian and allied lines of supply ran on the Danube and the Elbe by water and by wagon, and the huge hospital trains and siege parks made every turning of the army a logistical catastrophe.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一七四〇年十二月十五日普軍越境西里西亞起，至一七四八年十月十八日《阿亨條約》簽訂止，前後約八年，中間被一七四四年起法國的全面介入切成兩段：西段是一七四〇至一七四三年的西里西亞戰爭，東段是一七四四至一七四八年的多國戰爭，同期的波蘭王位繼承戰爭在名義上把法國與薩克森的爭端拉進同一個戰局。人口與兵力的對比極不均衡：普魯士全國人口約二百五十萬，哈布斯堡君主國合計約二千多萬，法國約一千九百多萬，僅大不列顛亦有八百萬上下。一七四一年四月九日的莫爾維茨會戰，常見引述的數字是普軍約二萬二千人、帝國聯軍約三萬人；一七四二年六月四日的霍恩弗里德貝格，雙方兵力仍大致相當，普軍約二萬餘人、奧軍約三萬人，但聯軍的損失遠重於普軍。一七四三年六月二十七日的德廷之戰，英國—漢諾威—奧地利聯軍約萬餘人至兩萬人，法軍貝勒伊爾麾下約兩萬三四千人。一七四五年五月十一日的豐特努瓦會戰，數字最為著名：法軍約八萬人、炮二十四門，聯軍約九萬人、炮約一百門，聯軍兵多而炮多，卻在法軍的集中炮兵與縱深部署面前崩潰，雙方傷亡與被俘合計以數千人計。人口與經濟方面，據當時估計西里西亞約佔普魯士人口三分之一，並帶來近兩成的國庫收入，失去它等於抽走普魯士最重要的財源與兵源。財政代價同樣具體：奧地利在戰後的支付困難促成了一七四八年確立的雙重附加稅制度，普魯士的國家債務在數年內膨脹數倍，常備軍規模倍增，役齡男子的徵召比例一度被提高到兩成。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war opened with the Prussian crossing into Silesia on 15 December 1740 and closed with the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle on 18 October 1748, a matter of about eight years, cut in two by the general intervention of France from 1744: the western phase was the Silesian war of 1740 to 1743, the eastern phase the general war of 1744 to 1748, while the War of the Polish Succession, running alongside, formally drew the French and Saxon disputes into the same settlement. The imbalance of population and armies was extreme: Prussia had about two and a half million inhabitants, the Habsburg dominions together something over twenty million, France about nineteen and a half million, and Britain alone around eight million. At Mollwitz on 9 April 1741 the figures usually quoted are about 22,000 Prussians against some 30,000 Imperial and allied troops; at Hohenfriedberg on 4 June 1742 the armies were still roughly matched, some twenty thousand Prussians against about thirty thousand Austrians, but the allied losses were far heavier than the Prussian. At Dettingen on 27 June 1743 the British, Hanoverian and Austrian allies numbered between sixteen and twenty thousand men, against some twenty-three or twenty-four thousand French under Belle-Isle. The numbers for Fontenoy on 11 May 1745 are the best known: about eighty thousand French with twenty-four guns against some ninety thousand allies with roughly a hundred guns, the allies having both more men and far more artillery and collapsing all the same before the concentrated French guns and the depth of the French deployment, casualties and prisoners on both sides numbering in the thousands. On population and finance, the estimate of the time put Silesia at about a third of the Prussian population and close to a fifth of the revenue of the treasury, so that losing it meant losing Prussia's richest source of money and of soldiers. The fiscal cost was equally concrete: the Austrian payment difficulties that followed the war produced the double tax system established in 1748, and the Prussian state debt multiplied several times over within a few years, the standing army doubled in size and the proportion of military-age men called up was at one point raised to a fifth.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是王位繼承的程序問題：一七一三年瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的父親查理六世以《波拉日克詔令》指定女兒及其後代繼承奧地利與匈牙利世襲領地，詔令經各邦逐一同意後生效，其中德意志諸邦也同意接受奧地利的女子繼承奧地利王位；然而巴伐利亞選侯查理·阿爾伯特主張詔令並未經帝國等級會議的有效同意，且所附條件未獲履行，因而主張帝國境內最接近的女性親屬有權取得普法爾茨。中層是國際格局：法國要拆散哈布斯堡的聯盟網，把巴伐利亞推到帝國王位競爭者的位置上，同時把奧地利的注意力釘在匈牙利與低地國家；波蘭方面，一七三三至一七三八年的波蘭王位繼承戰爭已經讓奧古斯特三世戴上了波蘭王冠，卻也把薩克森的選侯位與波蘭王位綁在一起，隨時可能成為法國的破口；英國與荷蘭願意以部隊和補貼援助哈布斯堡，但前提是瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的丈夫洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡必須當選德意志皇帝，否則他們在帝國的政策無從成立。最內層是普魯士的理由：腓特烈二世援引勃蘭登堡自一四七〇年起對西里西亞各公國的封建權利，並指控帝國違背《波拉日克詔令》、損害波蘭王室的利益，把這些主張寫成照會，作為越境的法理依據；同時他清楚知道奧地利正深陷匈牙利與巴伐利亞的事務，軍隊分散在西里西亞與匈牙利兩地，是他唯一能動手的窗口。真正的導火線是時序：一七四〇年十一月帝國等級會議在法國施壓下表態接受《波拉日克詔令》，同月普魯士提出異議並於十二月中旬宣戰開火，整場戰爭在幾週之內從一場王朝危機變成了歐洲戰爭。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The outermost was procedural, a question of how a succession was to be settled. In 1713 Charles VI had fixed the Pragmatic Sanction, naming his daughter and her descendants as heirs to the Austrian and Hungarian hereditary lands; the sanction took effect after each state had assented to it in turn, and the German states among them had agreed to accept a woman as sovereign of Austria. But the Elector of Bavaria, Charles Albert, maintained that the sanction had never received valid assent from the Imperial Diet, that its conditions had not been fulfilled, and that the nearest female relative in the Empire was therefore entitled to the Electoral Palatinate. The middle layer was the international alignment. France meant to break up the Habsburg network of alliances by pushing Bavaria into the place of a candidate for the imperial crown, and to pin Austrian attention on Hungary and the Low Countries; in Poland the War of the Polish Succession of 1733 to 1738 had already set the crown on Augustus III, but at the same time bound the Saxon electorate to the Polish crown and so left a permanent breach through which France might press. Britain and the Dutch Republic were willing to put troops and subsidies behind the Habsburgs, but on condition that Francis Stephen of Lorraine, Maria Theresa's husband, should be elected emperor; without that their policy in the Empire had no standing at all. The innermost layer was the Prussian case. Frederick II invoked the feudal rights of Brandenburg over the Silesian duchies dating from 1470, charged the Empire with violating the Pragmatic Sanction and with injuring the interests of the Polish crown, and set these claims down in a formal note as the legal ground for crossing the border. He also knew perfectly well that Austria was absorbed in the Hungarian and Bavarian business, that her armies were divided between Silesia and Hungary, and that this was the one window in which he could act. The true fuse was the sequence of events: in November 1740 the Imperial Diet, under French pressure, expressed its acceptance of the Pragmatic Sanction; in the same month Prussia lodged its protest and declared war in mid-December, and within a few weeks a dynastic crisis had become a European war.
impact: 影響分幾層。第一層是制度：帝國等級會議在一七四二年把《波拉日克詔令》定為帝國憲法的一部分，宣告女性可以繼承王位且不得被質疑，並以此駁回巴伐利亞對普法爾茨的要求；從此德意志的小邦無法再靠婚姻與繼承問題撬動帝國秩序，但與此同時，帝國的合法性被一份文件壟斷，選舉與權力的問題被推得更遠，留到下一個世紀才被重新處理。第二層是歐洲權力結構：普魯士憑藉西里西亞的礦產、糧食與人口，一躍成為歐洲列強之一，卻也從此被鎖在一場與奧地利的長期爭端裡，三場西里西亞戰爭的格局在此定型；哈布斯堡失去帝國西半部最富庶的一片領土，德意志的分裂從此不再只是名號上的問題，奧地利與普魯士成為德意志世界的兩極。第三層是軍事：奧地利在戰敗後進行系統性的軍制改革，一七四九年豪格維茨主持的帝國兵員份額制建立，奧地利的常備步兵整編為五十四個線狀步兵營與十五個擲彈兵營，騎兵整編為龍騎兵與驃騎，炮兵由國家統一掌管，並在維也納創辦軍事學校與工程學院；普魯士則把戰爭動員制度化，軍隊規模倍增，兵員徵召比例提高，並靠規模驚人的戰地醫院車隊把傷兵從前線一路帶回本土。第四層是外交：一七四八年的《阿亨條約》讓法國退出帝國戰場，也讓英國放棄對奧地利的援助，此後法奧結盟、俄國與奧地利靠攏，一七五六年開始的七年戰爭因此把普魯士孤立起來——這場戰爭最直接的後果之一，是把歐洲推向七年後的那一場全面對決。
impactEn: The effects run on several levels. The first is institutional. In 1742 the Imperial Diet made the Pragmatic Sanction part of the imperial constitution, declared that a woman could succeed to a crown and could not be questioned in the succession, and used it to defeat the Bavarian claim on the Palatinate. From then on the small German states could no longer use questions of marriage and inheritance to prise the Imperial order apart; at the same time, however, the legitimacy of the Empire was monopolised by a single document, and the questions of election and of the distribution of power were pushed further out, to be taken up again only in the following century. The second level is the European balance of power. Prussia, on the strength of the ore, the grain and the people of Silesia, became one of the European great powers in a single step, and at the same time was locked into a long quarrel with Austria: the pattern of the three Silesian wars was fixed here. The Habsburgs lost the richest territory in the western half of the Empire, and the division of Germany ceased to be a nominal question, with Austria and Prussia standing as the two poles of the German world. The third level is military. Austria carried out a systematic reform of its forces after the defeat: the quota system for Imperial contingents was established under Haugwitz in 1749, the Austrian line infantry was reorganised into fifty-four line regiments and fifteen grenadier regiments, the cavalry into dragoons and hussars, the artillery was placed under a single national authority, and military schools and an academy of engineering were founded in Vienna. Prussia made mobilisation a system, doubled the size of the army, raised the proportion of men called up, and carried its wounded home from the front on hospital trains of remarkable size. The fourth level is diplomatic. The Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle of 1748 took France out of the Imperial war and led Britain to abandon its support for Austria; afterwards France and Austria drew together, Russia drew close to Vienna, and the Seven Years War that began in 1756 found Prussia isolated. One of the most direct consequences of this war was to push Europe towards the general confrontation of seven years later.
result: 一七四五年五月《德累斯頓條約》先行了結普奧之間的戰事：普魯士保住西里西亞，作為交換支持瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的丈夫弗朗茨·斯特凡當選德意志皇帝，英國與荷蘭也據此停止對普魯士的補貼；帝國等級會議隨後以拉丁詔令重申《波拉日克詔令》與帝國的繼承原則。一七四七年七月拉費爾德會戰之後，聯軍在低地國家再無反攻能力，一七四八年秋法軍在里爾城下與聯軍達成協議：十月十八日簽訂的《阿亨條約》以大體維持戰前狀態收場，奧地利放棄對巴伐利亞普法爾茨的要求，確認洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡的皇帝地位；英國則以同一批條款與法國單獨議和，並保住北美的卡布頓島等戰時所得。從軍事的角度總結這場戰爭，最有意思的教訓來自豐特努瓦：聯軍以多出約一萬人的兵力與四倍多的火炮仍然戰敗，說明當時決定會戰的不是總數，而是炮兵能否集中、縱深是否足夠、指揮能否在斷裂處及時接上；普魯士以小國之力在三年內把西里西亞變成自己的領土，靠的是同一套紀律、同一種計畫速度與對時機的把握，而不是任何一件新式武器。輪發手槍在這場戰爭裡正是這條規律的註腳：當火槍、刺刀與火炮決定一切之後，價格昂貴而反應遲緩的輪發手槍只剩下最後的位置，在軍官與近衛的手上，成為一場已經改變了版圖的戰爭裡參戰者身分與榮譽的標記。
resultEn: The Treaty of Dresden of May 1745 first settled the war between Prussia and Austria: Prussia kept Silesia and in return supported the election of Francis Stephen of Lorraine, Maria Theresa's husband, as emperor, and Britain and the Dutch Republic accordingly stopped their subsidies to Prussia; the Imperial Diet then reaffirmed the Pragmatic Sanction and the principles of imperial succession in its Latin declaration. After the allied defeat at Lauffeld in July 1747 the allies had no more power to counterattack in the Low Countries, and in the autumn of 1748 the French came to terms with them before Lille: the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle of 18 October 1748 ended the war on a general restoration of the situation before it, Austria abandoned its claim on the Bavarian Palatinate and confirmed the imperial position of Francis Stephen of Lorraine, while Britain made a separate peace with France on the same terms and kept its wartime acquisitions such as Cape Breton in North America. Summing up the war on the military side, the most instructive lesson comes from Fontenoy: the allies were defeated with about ten thousand more men and four times the artillery, which showed that what decided a battle in those years was not the total but whether the guns could be concentrated, whether there was depth, and whether command could be joined up again in time at the point of rupture. Prussia turned Silesia into its own province within three years by the discipline, the speed of planning and the grasp of timing it had, and not by any new weapon. The wheellock pistol is the footnote to that rule: once musket, bayonet and cannon had settled everything, the costly and slow-firing wheel-lock had only the last place left, in the hands of officers and guards, as the mark of a participant's rank and honour in a war that had already redrawn the map.
